one_liner_zh: 雪佛龍EPS大超預期46%，營收年增3%下獲利大幅回升顯示成本控管與煉化利差改善。
one_liner_en: Chevron crushed EPS by 46% with earnings rebounding on cost discipline and better refining margins despite modest revenue growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期45.56%，獲利顯著優於預估，惟營收年增僅3.16%。
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏正但需審慎：45%的EPS超預期主要來自成本控管與煉化利差改善，而非營收（僅年增3%），獲利驚喜的持續性高度取決於油價與利差。短期股價對獲利回升反應正面，中期須緊盯油價走勢與上游產量。追蹤指標：每桶生產成本、上游產量、煉化利差、自由現金流、股息與回購覆蓋率，以及原油價格與供需。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive but warrants caution: the 46% EPS beat stems mainly from cost discipline and refining margins rather than revenue (up only 3%), so the surprise's durability hinges on oil prices and margins. Near-term the stock should respond well to the earnings rebound; mid-term, closely watch oil prices and upstream output. Track: per-barrel cost, upstream production, refining margins, free cash flow, dividend and buyback coverage, and crude price/supply-demand.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.41美元，遠超預期0.97美元，超預期幅度45.56%
營收475.6億美元，年增3.16%，獲利改善幅度遠大於營收成長
成本控管、產量提升與煉化利差改善推升獲利
穩健現金流支撑股息與回購，吸引收益型投資人
highlights_en: EPS of $1.41 vastly beat the $0.97 estimate by 45.56%
Revenue of $47.56B grew 3.16%, with earnings improving far more than the top line
Cost discipline, higher output and better refining margins boosted earnings
Solid cash flow supports dividends and buybacks, attracting income investors
risks_zh: 獲利高度受油價與煉化利差波動影響，能見度有限
營收年增僅3%，上游產量與油價是關鍵變數
能源轉型長期需求疑慮與資本配置壓力
risks_en: Earnings are highly exposed to oil-price and refining-margin volatility, limiting visibility
Revenue grew only 3%, with upstream output and oil prices the key swing factors
Long-term energy-transition demand concerns and capital-allocation pressure
